liveAppPrompts.title: What kind of Live App do you want to generate?

starter.title: Start from an idea
starter.description: Turn a business scenario into a runnable app
starter.prompt: Generate a Live App for managing a small team's daily tasks, with a task list, owners, due dates, status filters, and a new task form.

dashboard.title: Data dashboard
dashboard.description: Show metrics, trends, and filterable details
dashboard.prompt: Generate a Live App for a sales dashboard, with key metric cards, a trend chart, region filters, a customer details table, and an alerts area.

polish.title: Polish the experience
polish.description: Improve layout, states, empty screens, and visual detail
polish.prompt: Generate a Live App for event registration management, focusing on form experience, registration states, empty states, mobile layout, and visual hierarchy.

debug.title: Fix issues
debug.description: Find runtime errors and iterate quickly
debug.prompt: Check the current Live App for runtime issues, fix errors, slow interactions, or incorrect data display, and explain what changed.

agentAppPrompts.title: What kind of AI helper do you want?

starter.title: Run a repeatable routine
starter.prompt: Create a daily standup helper. It should ask what was done yesterday, what is planned today, and what is blocked, then summarize owners and next steps. Keep it cautious by default, do not edit files on its own, and give me a few opening prompts I can use right away.

tools.title: Check content or code
tools.description: Read first, suggest clearly, avoid surprise edits
tools.prompt: Create a review helper. It should inspect changes in the current folder, read diffs and relevant notes first, then point out risks, gaps, and suggestions. By default it should only advise, not edit files; if an edit is needed, it should explain exactly what it will change first.

examples.title: Draft replies for me
examples.prompt: Create a customer reply helper. It should write polite, clear replies from the ticket details I provide. If information is missing, it should ask me first; for complaints, refunds, or sensitive cases, it should remind me to confirm the policy before replying.

iterate.title: Improve an existing helper
iterate.description: Make it clearer, safer, and less likely to drift
iterate.prompt: Check the AI helper I edited most recently. Review whether its instructions, starter examples, and available tools are clear and safe. If anything is confusing or too broad, tighten it and summarize what changed.
